question: What establishes the domains within which manifestation is jointly present and outside which it is absent?
why_it_matters: Every theory of consciousness — naturalist, Pratyabhijñā, Buddhist, Nyāya, neutral monist — converges on the same missing object: Λ, the law that maps manifestation or organization into exclusive phenomenal domains. The universalization debate was a special case of this deeper problem.

candidate_explanations.name: Naturalist: organization → Λ → domain
candidate_explanations.best_case: Recurrent integration, counterfactual depth, global availability and causal autonomy at a specific scale produce a maximally integrated phenomenal domain. IIT's exclusion axiom is the closest attempt.
hard_to_vary_core: Phenomenal domains correlate with physical organization
Complexity and integration are necessary conditions
current_problems: Why is the relevant organization manifest rather than merely organized?
No settled criterion selects the subject scale

falsifiers.condition: Show that two systems with identical integration/complexity profiles have different phenomenal structures, or that one system produces two non-overlapping phenomenal fields.

candidate_explanations.name: Pratyabhijñā: C∞ → Λ → Dᵢ via Māyā/kañcukas
candidate_explanations.best_case: Universal manifest capacity contracts into local exclusion profiles through the five kañcukas. Finite subjects are locally exclusive articulations of unrestricted consciousness.
hard_to_vary_core: Finite subjects are not independent substances
current_problems: Why does unrestricted manifestation produce genuinely private exclusion?
Contraction specifies what must be explained, not how it occurs

falsifiers.condition: Show that a system with no kañcuka-like restrictions nevertheless possesses a phenomenal domain, or that kañcuka restriction alone fails to produce exclusivity.

candidate_explanations.name: Buddhist: reflexive moments → causal stream → conventional domain
candidate_explanations.best_case: Each cognition is reflexively manifest. Causal continuity, memory traces and affective appropriation produce conventionally individuated streams. No further owner required.
hard_to_vary_core: Reflexivity does not entail a subject
Continuity can be causal without numerical identity
current_problems: Why do reflexive moments form one co-conscious field rather than isolated atoms?
Conventional ownership does not explain manifestness across a stream

falsifiers.condition: Show that causal continuity between non-reflexive information states produces the same phenomenal features as a conscious stream.

candidate_explanations.name: Nyāya: substance-bearer → Λ → domain
candidate_explanations.best_case: Cognitive qualities inhere in an enduring individual self. Co-presence is explained by common inherence in one substance. Privacy is explained by different substances.
hard_to_vary_core: Plurality of substances explains privacy directly
current_problems: Why does inhering in one substance make qualities jointly manifest?
The substance itself is non-manifest — an additional relation is needed

falsifiers.condition: Show that two qualities inhering in one non-conscious substance do not become co-conscious, disproving inherence as the criterion.

candidate_explanations.name: Neutral monism: X → (Σ,D) domain pair
candidate_explanations.best_case: The intrinsic nature of physical structure is phenomenal. Each structural node has an intrinsic aspect, and the organization determines how these intrinsic aspects compose into domains.
hard_to_vary_core: The physical is not exhausted by its relational description
Intrinsic nature and extrinsic structure are dual aspects
current_problems: Why does one intrinsic-extrinsic pair map to THIS domain rather than overlapping or cosmic consciousness?
Relocates rather than solves the partition problem

falsifiers.condition: Show that any neutral monist mapping from structure to phenomenal domain is underdetermined by the structure alone.
